steps.note: typing on the base layer: one key per frame, like every keystroke here
the combo that puts the editor in vim mode
NORMAL: the board flips to commands
h — left, on the right index home
l — right; h j k l under four fingers, not QWERTY's accident
v — the combo on i and a; still NORMAL while it is pressed
VISUAL: e takes the selection to the end of the word
y — yank the selection, a combo on j and k; vim leaves VISUAL with it
back in NORMAL: p puts the word back, the combo one key to the left
INSERT: the vim layers step aside and the letters come back
Esc — b and m on Alpha 1, the same two positions as b and e on the vim layer
out of the editor: no vim layers at all
